about.body: The S63 is BMW M's twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 petrol engine, in production since 2010. It's the high-performance variant of BMW's N63 V8 family, developed specifically for M models — M5, M6, M8, X5 M and X6 M — across multiple generations. What distinguishes the S63 from its N63 sibling is a range of M-specific upgrades: stronger internals, higher boost pressure, more aggressive engine mapping, and in later iterations, M-specific lubrication and cooling enhancements. Applications we see most: The F90 M5 (2017–2023) and F95 X5 M are the two applications we work on most frequently for this engine, followed by the M8 and the earlier F10 M5. What we replace: Timing chain and tensioner components, bearings, gaskets and seals are replaced as standard across every S63 rebuild. Valve seals are also replaced as standard, given this engine's hot-vee architecture places the turbochargers in the V between the cylinder banks, which generates additional heat around the valvetrain. We also inspect and test the coolant system components, which are subject to the same thermal environment. Starting from: £5,500

byModel.body: Across the M5, the S63 has powered two generations — the F10 M5 (2011–2016) and the F90 M5 (2017–2023) — making it the longest-running single application for this engine. The M6 used it throughout its final generation (F06/F12/F13, 2012–2018), and the M8 continues with it in the current F91/F92/F93 generation. Across the SUV range, both the X5 M and X6 M use the S63 across their F85/F95 and F86/F96 generations respectively.

compatibility.body: Because the S63 spans six different M models and multiple generations, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec, which we do by registration. An S63 from an F10 M5 isn't a drop-in match for an S63 from an F95 X5 M, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries, mounting, cooling system configuration, and ECU/DME software all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
